chunks: Ahmad ibn Muhammad, from Uthman ibn Isa, from Abi Basir, from Abi Abdillah عليه السلام, who said:
If a man is found with a woman in a house at night, and there is no kinship relation between them, they are to be flogged.

key_terms.الرَّجُلُ: the man involved in the case
key_terms.امْرَأَةٍ: a woman involved in the case
key_terms.رَحِمٌ: a kinship relation making close family connection

ai.seo_question: What is the ruling if a man and a woman who are not related are found alone together at night?
ai.summary: This hadith states a legal ruling concerning a man and a woman found together in seclusion at night without a kinship bond between them. It reflects the jurisprudential concern for preventing illicit relations and safeguarding social and family boundaries.
